name: resilio-monorepo
description: Typed error presentation policy layer for React, Next.js, and TanStack

scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm pack:dry && pnpm test:packed
scripts.publish:preview: pnpm --filter @resiliojs/core publish --access public --no-git-checks && pnpm --filter @resiliojs/react publish --access public --no-git-checks && pnpm --filter @resiliojs/tanstack publish --access public --no-git-checks && pnpm --filter @resiliojs/next publish --access public --no-git-checks
